title: MV [Horror Mystery] Even20: The Interference of Parallels (Steam Demo Available!)

posts.author: silvereyes
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I’d like to share my upcoming RPG Maker MV project with you –
Even20: The Interference of Parallels
.
It’s a horror mystery RPG that I’ve been developing with a lot of care!
What began at the end of 2019 has grown over almost 6 years of development — and now, the game is finally about to be released!
Since the late 20th century, mysterious disappearances have been happening across Malaysia – from forests to hotels, schools, even airplanes.
In 2006, two students,
Liang
and
Huilin
, are suddenly dragged into a strange and terrifying parallel space while taking an elevator.
Separated in this distorted world, they must search for each other while uncovering the truth behind the disappearances.
But every choice you make will matter – leading to multiple endings, some hopeful, others… much darker.
6–8 hours of engaging gameplay
Enough time to uncover secrets, explore every corner, and experience multiple intense story moments.
Exploration & Puzzle Solving
In a complex and unfamiliar world, players will control different characters to investigate their surroundings. As the exploration deepens, more companions will join the journey, unlocking new story clues. By finding key items and solving puzzles, players can open sealed paths, overcome obstacles, and gradually uncover the truth behind the events.
Real-Time Action Combat System
The game features a fully ARPG-style real-time combat system. Enemies can appear at any moment during exploration, and players must make strategic use of weapons and skills to survive the dangers ahead.
Skill System
When facing powerful enemies, players can unleash special skills—such as slowing down time to escape danger, or briefly entering an invincible state to turn the tide of battle—adding layers of strategy and intensity to every encounter.
Multiple Endings
Decisions you make will alter the fate of the characters and the direction of the story, ultimately leading to one of five different endings.

️Try the Demo!​
The free demo is now live on Steam – about 1 hours of gameplay to give you a taste of the atmosphere and mechanics.
The price will be around $8.99, and there will be a special launch discount at release! Add it to your wishlist to get notified!
Feedback​
This is my first large-scale RPG Maker release, so I’d love to hear your feedback from the demo!
Every comment helps me improve the game before its full release this Fall 2025.
Want to share your thoughts or connect with other players? Join our
Discord
to give feedback, share suggestions, and be part of the community!
Thanks a lot for checking it out!
